study: Rose et al. 2017 — Research Learning Communities (RLC), EEF cluster RCT, primary, KS2 Reading/Numeracy/GPS, ERIC ED581267
delivery_evidence: Two 'Evidence Champion' teachers per school attended four face-to-face one-day RLC workshops per year over two years, delivered by UCL IOE academics with peers from up to four other schools at workshop venues; evaluators conducted in-person visits to RLC workshops (Intervention description, p.~10-13).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are KS2 Reading, Numeracy/Maths, and Grammar-Punctuation-Spelling — externally set/marked National Curriculum tests obtained from the National Pupil Database, broad independent standardized measures not tailored to RLC (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Tables 6-7, p.25-26).
curriculum_evidence: RLC PD aims to build teachers' capacity to engage with and apply research evidence to improve their own teaching/school-improvement strategies; no new curriculum or instructional-materials package is adopted; control = business-as-usual (Intervention description, p.~10-12).
outcome_timing_evidence: KS2 outcomes measured May 2016, at the end of the 2-year intervention (the 2014/15 Year-5 ITT cohort tested at KS2 in 2015/16) — immediate post (extraction timepoint=post, KS2 May 2016, end of 2-year intervention; Tables 6-7).
